description: This PHP class defines the RegistrationEventQueue entity for ORM mapping, representing a queue of registration events with properties like event type, timestamps, publication status, and associated data.

classes.name: RegistrationEventQueue
classes.description: Entity class for registration event queue, including constants for event types and properties for database columns.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the registration event queue record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the registration event queue record.

methods.name: isPublished
methods.description: Checks if the event has been published.

methods.name: getEventTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the event.

methods.name: setEventTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the event.

methods.name: getPublishTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the event was published.
